lines.text: [Verse 1]
You set your glass beside the phone
I take the long way past your door
A little smile, a raised eyebrow
We both know what we're waiting for
[Pre-Chorus]
Come a little closer, let the whole room turn
Say it with your eyes and let me make you burn
[Chorus]
Pull me into your orbit
Keep me right where the sparks begin
Pull me into your orbit
Let the night come rushing in
Pull me into your orbit
Don't let go until the morning
Don't let go until the morning
[Verse 2]
Your jacket's hanging on my chair
My lipstick marks the porcelain
You tell a story, lose your place
I catch you looking once again
[Pre-Chorus]
Come a little closer, let the whole room turn
Say it with your eyes and let me make you burn
[Chorus]
Pull me into your orbit
Keep me right where the sparks begin
Pull me into your orbit
Let the night come rushing in
Let the night come rushing in
Pull me into your orbit
Don't let go until the morning
Don't let go until the morning
[Bridge]
One step back, then you draw me near
A quiet promise only I can hear
(Ad-lib: Say it again) No need to hurry, no need to pretend
I'll take the long way around again
[Final Chorus]
Pull me into your orbit
Keep me right where the sparks begin
Pull me into your orbit
Let the night come rushing in
Let the night come rushing in
Pull me into your orbit
Don't let go until the morning
[Outro]
Until the morning
(Backing: Hold on, hold on) Pull me into your orbit
